about: The graduale of the formulary “Vigil of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Today you will know that the Lord will come and save us, and in the morning you will see His glory. Give ear, O You who rule Israel, You who lead Joseph like a sheep; You who sit upon the Cherubim, show Yourself before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasses.
